title: Event envelope with a __meta__ header and a __type__ payload discriminator
rationale: NP-022 in the form it actually reaches a consumer. A polymorphic payload silently loses the discriminator that tells the consumer which variant it is holding, and an entire metadata subtree disappears. Double-underscore metadata keys are standard in CDC and serialization envelopes, so this is not a contrived name.
catchesBugClass: Namespace collision between internal control data and user field names; silent field deletion with no error, warning, or count change reported anywhere.
cannotCatch: Only covers the both-ends form. The single-ended forms real pipelines emit more often pass through fine today, so this will not notice if the guard is later loosened to a startsWith check. It also does not cover the _value sentinel.

predicted.detail: Flattening is faithful; the loss is entirely in the reconstructor internal-marker guard. Correct fix is to stop putting markers in the user namespace, not to tighten the name pattern.
